name: What is topic cluster creation for AEO?

mainEntity.name: What is topic cluster creation for AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Topic cluster creation for AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) is a content strategy where a central 'pillar page' comprehensively covers a broad topic, linking to multiple 'cluster content' pages that delve into specific, related subtopics. This structure helps search engines understand the depth and breadth of your expertise, improving visibility for complex queries and featured snippets. For AEO, this method ensures your content directly answers user questions, positioning your site as an authoritative source for a wide range of related searches, which is crucial for appearing in rich results and voice search answers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Topic cluster creation for AEO organizes content around a central pillar page and supporting subtopic pages to improve search engine understanding and visibility for complex queries and rich results.
